title: An imported historical invoice is not sent to QuickBooks Online
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a test location whose QuickBooks Online connection is active, linked to a QuickBooks sandbox company you can sign in to.
  • Create a regular invoice for this test, invoice B, today at the test location, and let it reach QuickBooks, so you know the sync is running.
  • Create an import file for this test, file A, from the downloaded Invoices import template, with one Labor row: a new invoice number (invoice A), an existing customer, *Line Title "Replace tie rod" and Line Description "excessive play".
  • Write down the numbers of invoice A and invoice B.
  • Keep the QuickBooks sandbox company open in a second browser tab.
  • Start on Settings, then Invoices under Data Import in the Settings left menu.
custom_steps:
1. Upload file A.
  2. Wait 5 minutes without importing the file again.
  3. In the QuickBooks tab, search for invoice B's number.
  4. Search for invoice A's number.
  5. Switch to the ShopView tab.
  6. Click Reports in the top bar.
  7. Click QB Unexported in the Reports left menu.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The import finishes with "All invoices have been imported successfully.".

Step 2:

  • Five minutes have passed.

Step 3:

  • QuickBooks lists invoice B: the sync is running.

Step 4:

  • QuickBooks has no invoice with invoice A's number: the imported invoice was not sent.

Step 5:

  • The ShopView tab is in front.

Step 6:

  • The Reports page opens.

Step 7:

  • The QB Unexported list opens; invoice A is not in it on any tab: it was not tried and failed either.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "What Are You Doing / Why Are You Doing It?" (Title and Description), Confluence 845348896, version 15 (14 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11257, story SV-10132 (Story 3, What Reaches QuickBooks)

  • S3-R12: “An imported historical invoice never reaches the live QuickBooks sync, so its line text is unaffected whatever the import wrote into it.”
  • Feature Overview, Core functionality: “The historical invoice import (Administration → Invoices) renames its two columns to match, and still accepts the old column names, so no spreadsheet a shop already holds stops working. It is the only live import that carries these columns.”

From: Jira tickets and comments under epic SV-11257, and bug SV-11850 (saved in sources/jira-2026-10-27/ALL-TICKETS-2026-10-27.md), read 27 Oct 2026

  • SV-10133, Nemanja Djuric, 8 Oct 2026 (Ready for QA testing): “Fill the downloaded template with one Labor row and import it: "All invoices have been imported successfully.", and the invoice opens with the title and description in the right places.”
